text:
On my first visit, I was impressed by the male dentist; he was polite, did a good job, and was gentle.
Today, I saw a female dentist. I was there for a filling as the male dentist had said, and I could use my government health insurance. Today, the female dentist said she couldn't do it because the hole was too big and told me to come back another day with the first male dentist. She told me to do other teeth first. While she was working on my tooth, she got a phone call and talked for several minutes without telling me to keep my mouth open. I closed my mouth because it was getting tired, and waited for her to finish the call. The dentist got annoyed and said I closed my mouth, and she had to do everything again. She was very heavy-handed and sighed loudly periodically. She was working on my tooth with a bad temper. My mouth hurt so much. When it was finished, the staff told me that the first male dentist had said I could use my government health insurance, but it turned out I couldn't anymore. Lol, it's funny that this happens. I've already paid a lot for dental work here, and now that I'm using my government health insurance, it's like I'm worthless as a customer.
I can go to another clinic. This is terrible.😩
